result.instructions: Tools for Userlike, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which conversations are still open for my team today?"; "Show me the notes and recent conversations for this contact."; "Add an internal note to the conversation about the refund request.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Userlike data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run userlike_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run userlike_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run userlike_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. userlike_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: userlike_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List conversations with contacts (newest first by default). Filter by operator, status, search text or update time. GET /api/um/v3/conversations/.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100 (the API default is 10).

offset.description: Offset for offset pagination (up to 10,000 results).

operator_id.description: Only conversations of this operator id.

status.description: Conversation status filter, as the API defines it (for example new).

updated_at_from_date.description: Only conversations updated at or after this time.

contact_first_message_from_date.description: Only conversations whose contact wrote first at or after this time.

tools.name: userlike_get_conversation
tools.title: Get conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation by id. GET /api/um/v3/conversations/{id}/.

tools.name: userlike_list_conversation_messages
tools.title: List conversation messages
tools.description: List the messages of one conversation, using cursor pagination (pass the cursor from the previous page). GET /api/um/v3/conversations/{id}/messages/.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100 (the API default is 10).

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next link (cursor pagination).

tools.name: userlike_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (contact identities) of the organization, with optional text search and ordering (for example email or -email). GET /api/um/v3/contact_identities/.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100 (the API default is 10).

offset.description: Offset for offset pagination (up to 10,000 results).

ordering.description: Sort field, for example email or -email.

tools.name: userlike_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id. GET /api/um/v3/contact_identities/{id}/.

tools.name: userlike_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: Update fields of one contact. Only the fields you pass change; the rest stay as they are. The contact's data is overwritten, so check the id first. PATCH /api/um/v3/contact_identities/{id}/.

salutation.description: How the contact wants to be addressed (for example mrs or prof).

gender.description: Contact gender code, for example m or f.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, for example DE.

external_customer_id.description: Your own customer id for this contact.

contact_by_email.description: Whether the contact accepts email contact.

contact_by_phone.description: Whether the contact accepts phone contact.

custom_field_data.description: Custom field values, keyed by the custom field id.

tools.name: userlike_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List internal notes, optionally only those of one conversation or one contact. GET /api/um/v3/notes/.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100 (the API default is 10).

offset.description: Offset for offset pagination (up to 10,000 results).

conversation_id.description: Only notes of this conversation id.

contact_identity_id.description: Only notes of this contact id.

tools.name: userlike_get_note
tools.title: Get note
tools.description: Get one note by id. GET /api/um/v3/notes/{id}/.

tools.name: userlike_create_note
tools.title: Create note
tools.description: Add an internal note to one conversation or one contact. Pass exactly one of conversation_id or contact_identity_id. The note is visible to operators, not to the contact. POST /api/um/v3/notes/.

conversation_id.description: Conversation to note (leave out for a contact note).

contact_identity_id.description: Contact to note (leave out for a conversation note).

tools.name: userlike_list_operators
tools.title: List operators
tools.description: List the operators (agents) of the organization. GET /api/um/v3/operators/.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100 (the API default is 10).

offset.description: Offset for offset pagination (up to 10,000 results).

ordering.description: Sort field, for example name or -name.

tools.name: userlike_get_operator
tools.title: Get operator
tools.description: Get one operator by id. GET /api/um/v3/operators/{id}/.

tools.name: userlike_get_operator_slots
tools.title: Get operator slots
tools.description: Get one operator's chat slot use (free, used, total, availability). Use it to check capacity before routing work. GET /api/um/v3/operators/{id}/slots/.

tools.name: userlike_set_operator_away
tools.title: Set operator away status
tools.description: Set one operator to away (true) or back online (false). An away operator receives no new chats. PATCH /api/um/v3/operators/{id}/away/.

away.description: true sets the operator to away; false sets the operator back online.
